Building frontier AI on consumer hardware.

projects.description: Quillan-Ronin is an open-source sovereign AI runtime: a 34-expert council Mixture-of-Experts architecture with BitNet 1.58-bit quantization, diffusion-based reasoning refinement, and a 9B virtual-agent swarm, designed to run capable AI locally on consumer hardware. Includes published fine-tuned models on Hugging Face (71K+ downloads).
